title: Australian Meat Pie
description: A classic Australian comfort food, perfect for a cold day. Moist and flavorful, this pie is sure to become a favorite.
instructions: Roll out the pie crust and place in a pie dish.
In a pan, cook the ground beef over medium heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the onion and carrots to the pan and cook until they are softened.
Add the flour to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the breadcrumbs, egg, and milk. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Pour the filling into the pie crust.
Roll out the remaining pie crust and use it to cover the pie. Crimp the edges to seal.
Cut a few slits in the top crust to allow steam to escape.
Bake the pie for 25-30 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.
